device: iPhone 16 Pro (iPhone17,1) real device, iOS 27.0.1, 402x874 pt @3x; rows at the display link (60 Hz while the bar idles between gestures)
probe: tool/ios_reference (device.sh PROBE_PLAN=tablook / tabglowdrag, PROBE_TABLAYERS=1, PROBE_DARK); recorded 2026-10-03
format: jsonl. k=start {t, scene, rec, scale, maxfps, w, h}; k=touch {t, phase 0 began / 1 moved / 3 ended, x, y} (window points, media clock); k=big = _UIFlexInteraction.BigGlow presentation {a opacity, w, h, x (window bbox; the glow container rides the bar swell)}; k=little = _UIFlexInteraction.LittleGlow {a opacity, x, y, w (window bbox), s (layer transform scale)}. Rows are logged only when a value changed. The glows sit in _UIFlexInteractionGlowContainerView over the bar glass and under the tab content; both carry vibrantColorMatrix filters: BigGlow (white) adds 0.05 per channel at opacity 1 (rows sum to 1), LittleGlow multiplies by 4.0 (dark) / 1.667 (light). Peaks equal the bar flex spec (274 x 62): bigGlowOpacity 0.845, littleGlowOpacity 0.2845.
